Replace only the white background around the photographed product and reframe with the SAME photographed camera angle; retain photographed shape and proportions without stretching or inventing hidden ends. Place the product in the lower half of the landscape composition with generous dark quiet upper 48% and center space for HTML heading, full near end section visible, enough side margins for responsive cropping. No embedded text, logo, dimensions, arrows or certifications. No extra masking that darkens the product. Natural restrained metallic detail; don't invent fine machining texture. Preserve exactly TWO separate double-V lower die blocks from image 1, same relative size, arrangement and perspective. Each block has exactly TWO PARALLEL V GROOVES SIDE BY SIDE ON ITS SAME UPPER FACE, one small and one large as photographed, running along its existing length; keep the front end's W-shaped top edge with its middle land. At BOTTOM each block has a RECTANGULAR LOCATING RECESS, with horizontal flat top inside the recess: this is NOT a V groove. There is NO V groove on the underside or either side. Do not convert into a top-and-bottom opposed V, do not combine two blocks into one, do not extend the photograph's cropped far ends. Preserve near-end proportions and all visible shoulders.
records.geometryReview: Two separate dies, each with two parallel V grooves on the same top face. Original flat-topped rectangular bottom locating recesses retained; no opposed bottom V. Relative positions, unequal groove widths and visible front sections compared against target photograph.
